items.summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. items.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. items.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. items.summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. items.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows.
